QuestInfo.name: Using Magic Claw
QuestInfo.0: Power B. Fore at the training center wants you to learn how to use a new skill.
QuestInfo.1: Power B. Fore is teaching you how to use a new skill. Use Magic Claw to eliminate some Slimes.\r\n\r\n#o210100# #a24161# (Use Magic Claw)
QuestInfo.2: You used Magic Claw to eliminate some Slimes.
QuestInfo.summary: Use Magic Claw to eliminate 30 Slimes.

0.0: Hey, thanks! I was able to get back my letter of commendation thanks to you. Shall we start with the training now? You know what skills are, right? Use them wisely, and you'll be able to perform attacks that are more powerful than you're normally capable of. What do you think? Want to give it a try?

yes.0: Okay, now use Magic Claw to defeat 30 Slimes.

no.0: I thought you told me you wanted to train.

1.0: Great... great work there. I can see you were diligent in your training, so let me give you a boost on leveling up.

mob.0: You haven't defeated all the Slimes yet.
